title: W5 E1 -- Sidebar search clear button and Escape
description: docs/agent-work/2026-11-01-ui-wave-5/PLAN.md section 'Amendment 1' ### E1. EVERY vite build/Playwright run takes node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/serial-check.lock. Private config/port; double-quote paths; no git stash/checkout/reset/restore; no installs; no commits; no BoardUI installs.

review.note: Reviewed E1 diff (.search block in ProjectSidebar.tsx, .search rules in styles.css) and tests/sidebar-search.spec.ts. Code: button is visibility:hidden + tabIndex -1 when query empty (out of tab order and a11y tree), aria-label Clear search, click clears and refocuses input, Escape clears non-empty query with stopPropagation only then (empty Escape falls through to the sidebar overlay-close handler at ProjectSidebar ~876/901; covered by a test), kbd shares a grid cell and is hidden via :has() while clear shows, reuses .icon-button recipe (no new hover/scale/stroke rule), no fill, square, fade is opacity+visibility with --duration-fast, instant under Reduce Motion, floating.css transparent rule covers .search. Own run (Node v22.23.3, lock held and released): tsc rc=0; vitest designTokens/motion/hoverEmphasis 36 pass; vite build ok; playwright sidebar-search + sidebar-selection + layout + hover-emphasis + floating = 59 passed, 3 failed, all in floating.spec.ts citation card (lines 493, 580, 676), which belong to C5/T213 in progress, not E1. Log: node_modules/.cache/personal-word-beta/ui5-e1r/pw.log; shots in ui5-e1r/shots (16 written). Fail-first: ui5-e1/failfirst-pw.log shows 6 behaviour tests failing for the right reasons (clear button not found; Escape left value abc; fade/floating locators not found). Screenshots: all 16 opened (light/dark x plain/color x docked/floating x empty/text): every empty state shows the cmd-K hint and no button; every text state shows a plain X and no hint; no fill or box around the X; floating variants show no surface behind the search.
